title: The Campus Library Orientation: A Step-by-Step Guide
instructions: 阅读下面的文章，回答10个问题。文章是关于大学图书馆新生导览的模拟材料。请仔细阅读，答案必须来自文章。
passage:
Welcome to the Campus Library Orientation. This guide explains the steps that new students should follow during their first visit. The library is a large building with three floors, and each floor has a different purpose. The orientation is designed to help you use the library effectively.

A. Before You Enter
Before you enter the library, you need to have your student card ready. The card is required for entry, and it is also used to borrow books. If you do not have your card, you cannot enter. The main entrance is on the ground floor, next to the information desk. The information desk is staffed by librarians who can answer your questions. Opening hours are from 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. on weekdays, and from 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. on weekends.

B. The Ground Floor
When you enter, you will see the information desk on your left. Here, you can pick up a map of the library. The map shows the location of all sections. The ground floor contains the borrowing and return desk, where books are checked out and returned. You can borrow up to five books at a time for two weeks. If you return books late, you will pay a fine of one yuan per day per book. Also on the ground floor, there is a café where you can buy drinks and snacks. The café is open from 8:30 a.m. to 8:00 p.m.

C. The First Floor
The first floor is the main study area. It has long tables with lamps, and it is a quiet zone. You must not talk loudly here. There are also group study rooms, which can be booked online. Each room can hold up to six people. To book a room, you need to use the library website. The rooms are popular, so you should book at least one day in advance. On this floor, you will also find the photocopy machines. They are located near the stairs. You need your student card to use the photocopiers.

D. The Second Floor
The second floor houses the main book collection. Books are arranged by subject, and each subject has a different color label. The labels help you find books quickly. The second floor also has computers for searching the library catalogue. These computers are free to use, but you need to log in with your student number. If you need help finding a book, ask a librarian at the help desk on this floor. The help desk is open from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.

E. Borrowing and Returning Books
To borrow a book, take it to the borrowing desk on the ground floor. You must show your student card. The librarian will scan the book and your card. You will receive a receipt with the due date. Books must be returned by the due date. If you need more time, you can renew books online once. Renewals give you an extra two weeks. You cannot renew a book if someone else has reserved it. Reserved books must be returned within three days.

F. Using the Online Catalogue
The library catalogue can be accessed from any computer on campus or from your own device. You can search for books by title, author, or subject. The catalogue shows whether a book is available or on loan. If a book is on loan, you can reserve it. When the book is returned, you will receive an email notification. You can then pick it up at the borrowing desk within two days.

G. Rules and Conduct
All users are expected to respect the library rules. Food and drink are only allowed in the café area. Mobile phones must be set to silent mode. Group discussions should take place in the group study rooms, not in the quiet zone. Library staff may ask you to leave if you break the rules. Remember, the library is a shared space, and everyone has the right to study in a peaceful environment.

We hope this orientation helps you make the most of the library. If you have any questions, please ask at the information desk.

grammar.title: 被动语态；顺序连接词；定语从句与分词短语的辨认
grammar.explanation: 被动语态表示主语是动作的承受者，结构为be+过去分词。顺序连接词如first, then, next, finally用来表示步骤顺序。定语从句用who, which, that等引导，修饰名词；分词短语用现在分词或过去分词短语作定语或状语。
grammar.example: The card is required for entry, and it is also used to borrow books.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct passive form: The books ______ by the librarian every morning.
questions.explanation: 主语books是复数，被动语态用are+过去分词。
questions.evidence: The books are checked by the librarian every morning.

questions.prompt: Which word is a sequence connector?
questions.explanation: First是顺序连接词，表示第一步。
questions.evidence: First, you need to have your student card ready.

questions.prompt: Identify the relative clause in: 'The librarian who helped me was very kind.'
questions.explanation: who helped me是定语从句，修饰the librarian。
questions.evidence: The librarian who helped me was very kind.

questions.prompt: Identify the participle phrase in: 'Walking into the library, she saw the information desk.'
questions.explanation: Walking into the library是现在分词短语作状语。
questions.evidence: Walking into the library, she saw the information desk.
